english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “madness” means mental illness or insanity.
Use this for a serious mental illness or disorder.

examples.english: They have madness and need to be hospitalized.
examples.traditional: 佢有精神病，要入院治療。

examples.english: He has a serious mental disturbance and needs treatment.
examples.traditional: 佢有精神病，需要接受治療。
